subject: ClearTrust DR readiness — rehearsal logistics and evidence pull
messages:
From: Emily Rivers <emily.rivers@cleartrust.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: DevOps Team <devops@cleartrust.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ClearTrust DR rehearsal — request for evidence pull and ops timeline

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the time on the call this morning. As part of ClearTrust's vendor resilience assessment we want to run a short, observed DR rehearsal next month to validate failover steps and capture RTO/RPO artifacts. We'd like Redwood to provide:

- a short checklist of the rehearsal steps your team will run
- RTO and RPO measurement samples (recent run or sample traces)
- a snapshot of any KV/cache warm-state evidence you can provide (timestamped)
- owner contact list and expected witness windows (1–2 hour window we'd observe)

Target window from our side: week of Aug 4–8. Can you confirm if Redwood can support a 2-hour witnessed dry-run and pull the evidence ahead of the rehearsal? Also include any special access or non-disclosure steps we should be aware of.

Appreciate a quick note with what's feasible and suggested dates.

Cheers,
Emily Rivers
Senior Vendor Risk Analyst
ClearTrust Bank
emily.rivers@cleartrust.com

(Attachment: CTB_DR_SOW_Request.pdf)

From: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
To: Emily Rivers <emily.rivers@cleartrust.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Jul 2025 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearTrust DR rehearsal — request for evidence pull and ops timeline

Emily —

Thanks — we can support a witnessed rehearsal during the week of Aug 4–8. High level:

- Proposed witness window: Aug 5, 14:00–16:00 PDT (we can provide alternate 09:00–11:00 slot)
- Targeted RTO approach for the rehearsal: failover to warm standby in a single AZ -> measured RTO aim: <= 2 hours
- RPO: typical across our customers for this workload is <= 15 minutes; we'll provide sample replication lag traces and a KV-cache snapshot with timestamps
- Deliverables we will upload beforehand: runbook excerpt, rehearsal checklist, sample traces, and a brief ops run-deck

I've looped in Karthik (infrastructure) and Olga (ops) to coordinate the evidence pull and any ticketing/zoom logistics. We'll attach the runbook excerpt and checklist by end of day tomorrow.

Mina Haddad
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai
(Attachment: none in this message)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Jul 2025 13:25:44 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearTrust DR rehearsal — request for evidence pull and ops timeline

Team —

Operational notes / ask list for the evidence pull:

1) RTO/RPO traces: pull the last three scheduled failovers and a recent warm-standby activation (if available). Export timestamped telemetry:
   - orchestration start/stop timestamps
   - KV cache invalidation/warmup times
   - DNS propagation times (if any)
2) KV/cache snapshot: export a read-only archive with manifest (include snapshot timestamp and sequence id). Limit PII — mask customer identifiers; ClearTrust asked for a sample, not production data.
3) Runbook snippet: extract the "warm failover" section and the checklist steps we will run during the witnessed rehearsal.
4) Access notes: for the witness session we'll create a temporary viewer role and a signed link to the replay traces. Ops to confirm retention window for the signed link (min 7 days).

Olga — can you own the exports above and drop them into the shared drive under /CTB/DR/ by EOD Jul 11? Marcus — please stand by for a quick walkthrough on the run-deck.

-Karthik
Lead, Infrastructure Reliability
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 10:05:02 -0700

Folks —

Quick status: I'm pulling the artifacts now. Deliverables planned to be uploaded to the shared folder by 17:00 PDT today (Jul 11):

- CTB_DR_Runbook_v2.pdf (runbook excerpt, with redactions on account identifiers)
- CTB_DR_Rehearsal_Checklist.xlsx (step-by-step checklist we will run during the observed rehearsal)
- kv_cache_snapshot_20250710.tar.gz (read-only snapshot manifested and hashed; contains metadata only, no PII)
- rto_rpo_traces_202504-202507.zip (three sample traces and the latest warm-standby activation trace)

Notes:
- Snapshot manifest includes sequence id: seq-20250710-042 and UTC timestamp.
- Links will be time-limited; I will create viewer links valid for 7 days and share the URLs along with a one-time token in a follow-up message.
- We will need ClearTrust to sign an additional NDA addendum before providing the snapshot archive; legal has pre-approved the text (see JIRA SEC-7289).

I'll also schedule a 30-minute ops walkthrough (internal) on Jul 14 at 09:30 PDT for Marcus/Karthik/Mina to rehearse the run-deck.

Olga Petrov
Senior Ops Manager, Platform Reliability
olga.petrov@redwood.ai

Mina / Olga / Karthik —

Thanks — this looks good and aligns with our needs. Two quick items from ClearTrust:

1) NDA addendum: we can sign the brief addendum; please send the DocuSign link and we'll route it to legal today.
2) Witness window: Aug 5, 14:00–16:00 PDT works for our team. We'll join as observers and will not request any write access.

Please go ahead with uploading the runbook excerpt and traces. Once we have the viewer links and the signed NDA, we'll confirm the rehearsal invite and send a short agenda (10–12 bullets).

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
